ui_entry_missing: This Forge build does not expose the required img2img sub-tab components. SnapRef UI cannot be installed safely.
reference_tab_disabled: Enable SnapRef in Reference Generation, or switch to the original img2img tab for ordinary image editing.
title: Character Reference Generation (SnapRef)
intro: The img2img image is a character reference. Generate a new scene from fresh noise at the selected size; denoising strength is not used. Inpaint is unsupported. PNG Info restores settings; please select reference images again.
use_main: Use current img2img image as reference
preview: Character reference image (drop, paste or upload)
upload: Drop, paste or upload a reference
strength_info: 1 = trained reference attention weight; 0 = off; 2 = twice. Does not scale LoRA weights.
fidelity_info: 1 = trained default; lower values add reference to the negative branch at weight (1 − Fidelity). Ignored with Reference in Unconditional or Reference Guidance.
resolution_info: Keep aspect ratio; only downscale, never enlarge. Each separate image has this limit.
layout_info: Separate: views of the same character. Stitch: left-to-right at the first image's height; different characters may mix identities. Individual weights are ignored in Stitch (zero still skips an image).
weights_info: 0–2 per image, in order: main image first (if used), then gallery. Missing entries default to 1; 0 skips encoding. Reorder weights when reordering images.
guidance_info: One extra model evaluation per step until this fraction. Incompatible with Spectrum/forecasting wrappers.
caption: Reference Caption (optional appearance tags)
log_bias_info: 0 = unchanged; +1 multiplies reference attention weight by e. Added to log(Strength × image weight).
ready: Compatible Anima structure: {blocks} blocks. Backend checks again before sampling.
adapter_missing: Adapter missing; first enabled generation downloads it from the official Hugging Face repository.
anima_only: SnapRef requires an actual Anima engine and transformer. Select an Anima checkpoint.
unsupported_layout: Unsupported SnapRef block mapping: {adapter} adapter blocks → {blocks} model blocks. 52-block models are not verified.
unsupported_structure: This model structure or conditioning layout is not supported by SnapRef.
max_references: SnapRef supports at most 8 references, including the main image.
bad_weights: Reference weights must be finite comma-separated numbers between 0 and 2.
no_reference: Select at least one reference image with a positive weight.
inpaint_unsupported: SnapRef character generation requires the plain img2img input. Disable it to use inpaint or masks.
hires_unsupported: Hires/refiner processing is not supported in SnapRef character generation.
native_reference_conflict: Disable native Anima Reference/Edit and ImageStitch references before using SnapRef. Their latent reference routes cannot be combined safely.
extension_conflict: Another extension modifies reference attention: {detail}. Disable the conflicting feature before using SnapRef.
guidance_conflict: Reference Guidance cannot run with Spectrum or another model forecasting wrapper. Turn off one of these features.
cancelled: SnapRef generation/download cancelled; model state restored.
nonfinite: SnapRef produced non-finite tensors. Sampling stopped; model state restored. Try BF16 computation and a lower reference resolution.
oom: SnapRef ran out of GPU memory. Model hooks were restored. Reduce reference resolution, image count or batch size.
no_model_directory: No writable Forge model directory is available.
license_notice: Pretrained SnapRef weights use the CircleStone Labs Non-Commercial License, not GPL. The first enabled generation downloads weights from https://huggingface.co/0ppxnhximxr/snapref-v2a-pre2. Review the model license before use.
download_integrity: SnapRef download size or SHA256 verification failed.
download_failed: SnapRef download failed: {detail}. Check the network or place official weights in the Forge LoRA directory, then rescan.
reload_images: PNG settings restored. Select the reference images again; images are not embedded in SnapRef metadata.
